column1: #mapping_set_title: "IBM AI Risk Atlas to the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025, two risks"

#mapping_set_description: "Mappings of two IBM risks from the OWASP mapping set in IBM AI Atlas Nexus. The curators wrote a rejected candidate, and a risk with no candidate, with the predicate noMatch. Here the first is a negated skos:relatedMatch and the second a skos:relatedMatch to sssom:NoTermFound, as in IBM/ai-atlas-nexus#299."

column8: Relates to explainability which is not covered in OWASP
